# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Window and Application Header

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "invoices.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc"
- **System Information Bar**: Shows "Oct 23 16:33" and system icons (notification bell)
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **Application Icon**: LibreOffice Calc icon on the top-left corner

## Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help
- **Active Menu**: "Format" menu is currently open, indicated by its highlighted state

## Format Menu Dropdown

- **Top-Level Options**:
  - Text
  - Align Text
  - Number Format
  - Clone Formatting
  - Clear Direct Formatting (Ctrl+M)
  - Cells... (Ctrl+1)
  - Rows
  - Columns
  - Merge and Unmerge Cells
- **Submenu Options**:
  - Character...
  - Paragraph...
  - Page Style...
  - Print Ranges
  - Conditional
  - AutoFormat Styles...
  - Spreadsheet Theme
  - Image
  - Chart
  - Object
  - Name...
  - Description...
  - Anchor
  - Arrange
  - Flip
  - Group

## Toolbar

- **Quick Access Toolbar**: Contains icons for common actions
- **Formatting Toolbar**: Includes icons for:
  - Font selection (Calibri)
  - Text alignment
  - Number formatting
  - Cell formatting (border, fill, font style)
  - Data manipulation (sort ascending/descending)
  - Object insertion (image, chart, etc.)
  - Formula and function insertion
  - Special characters (Ω)
  - Linking and commenting
  - Grid and table formatting
  - Drawing tools (pen, shapes)

## Worksheet Area

- **Grid Layout**: Standard spreadsheet grid with rows (1-36) and columns (A-Q)
- **Selected Cell**: Cell G2 is highlighted with a blue background
- **Data Content**:
  - **Column A**: Invoice Number (INV-2023-001 to INV-2023-010)
  - **Column D**: Item Description (Graphic Design, Marketing Strategy, etc.)
  - **Column E**: Quantity (4, 3, 1, etc.)
  - **Column F**: Unit Price (366.83, 60.43, 114.5, etc.)
  - **Column G**: Total (1467.32, 181.29, 114.5, etc.)
  - **Column H**: Payment Status (Paid, Pending, Overdue)

## Sidebar

- **Vertical Scrollbar**: On the right side of the worksheet
- **Sidebar Icons**: Contains icons for:
  - Navigator
  - Styles
  - Functions (fx)
  - Chart
  - Image
  - Object

## Status Bar

- **Sheet Information**: "Sheet 1 of 1"
- **Sheet Name**: "Invoices"
- **Page Style**: "PageStyle_Invoices"
- **Language**: "English (Hong Kong)"
- **Statistics**: "Average: 1467.32; Sum: 1467.32"
- **Zoom Control**: "100%" with zoom slider

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Sidebar**: Contains application launcher icons (Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Software, Help, Trash)
- **Bottom Panel**: Contains system tray icons and application launcher grid

## Additional UI Elements

- **Help Prompts**: "Help us make LibreOffice" and "Your donations support" with "Get involved" and "Donate" buttons
- **Cell Reference**: "G2" displayed in the formula bar
- **Formula Bar**: Displays cell reference and formula input area
- **Sheet Tab**: "Invoices" tab is active

## Visual Design

- **Color Scheme**: Light gray background with blue highlights for selected cells
- **Font**: Calibri for text
- **Icons**: Standard system icons for applications and functions
- **Layout**: Clean, organized, and intuitive for spreadsheet operations

## Functional Elements

- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Visible for "Clone Formatting" (Ctrl+M) and "Cells..." (Ctrl+1)
- **Interactive Elements**: Dropdown menus, buttons, and icons that respond to user input
- **Data Visualization**: Numbers and text are clearly displayed in a tabular format
- **Navigation**: Scrollbars and sheet tabs for easy navigation

## Contextual Information

- **File Name**: "invoices.xlsx"
- **Application**: LibreOffice Calc
- **Date
